title: Convertible Top — Controls and Operating Conditions
introduction:
The convertible top uses a lead-and-partner arrangement: smart motor modules coordinate roof movement, while the driver keeps the switch held in the requested direction. I read the opening and closing conditions separately, because each direction has its own permission checklist.

This overview applies to the convertible-top system on convertible vehicles. It explains control logic and operating conditions; it does not teach latch handling, tonneau-cover removal, manual roof operation or fault testing.

edits.text: The convertible top is controlled by 2 smart electric motors called the Moveable Roof Control Module A (MRCMA) and the Moveable Roof Control Module B (MRCMB). The Moveable Roof Control Module A (MRCMA) is the primary system module; it communicates with other modules and the Moveable Roof Control Module B (MRCMB) over MS-CAN. To raise or lower the roof, hold the convertible top switch in the corresponding up or down position throughout the movement. Operation requires the applicable conditions below:
edits.why: The primary module coordinates the system through network communication. Holding the switch is part of the operating method, while the conditions below determine whether the requested movement is permitted.
All conditions in this opening list must be met.

edits.text: The accessory delay relay must be active.
edits.why: This is a required system state; this overview does not specify how to activate or test the relay.

edits.text: Vehicle speed must be less than 5 km/h (3 mph).
edits.why: The speed requirement is strictly below the stated threshold.

edits.text: The convertible top latch switch must be open.
edits.why: “Open” describes the required switch state. It does not supply a physical latch-release procedure.
All conditions in this closing list must be met.

edits.text: The accessory delay relay must be active.
edits.why: Closing requires this relay state as well as the other conditions in this list.

edits.text: Vehicle speed must be less than 5 km/h (3 mph).
edits.why: The same strictly-below speed requirement applies during closing.

edits.text: Tonneau covers, if equipped, must not be in place.
edits.why: This closing condition applies only when the vehicle has tonneau covers. Their removal method belongs to the applicable operating instructions.
